svg.title: How DC-1 is proved, and a test on dependent rows
svg.desc: The five proof steps of the concentration bound under a declared dependency coloring, and a test on overlapping windows of fair bits with design factor 3n.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: HOW DC-1 IS PROVED, AND A TEST ON DEPENDENT ROWS
Five steps from one event to the whole law. Only step 3 needs independence, and only inside a color.
Fix a set A of cells.
take t = ε/2 and a union
DC-1: P(‖Pn − P‖1 ≥ ε) ≤ (2K − 2) exp(−n2ε2 / 2Vn), Vn = (Σa √na)2​
Vn is the design factor: Vn = n for independent rows (all rows in one color), and Vn = rn when r colors hold n/r rows each.
Test: 300 overlapping windows of three fair bits (20,000 runs); colors t mod 3, so Vn = 3n
the bound with Vn = n, as if independent

DC-1 curve at every ε. The 95%

Proof: pid-rs dependency-color note (Janson 2004; Pelekis et al. 2017; Weissman et al. 2003). Monte Carlo seed 20260930.
